title: Light Indian Mars Bar Biryani
description: A paleo-friendly Indian dish featuring Mars Bar and ferment-kimchi, perfect for a quick dessert or snack.
instructions: Heat Coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Basmati rice and cooking liquid, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 15 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and fluffy.
While the rice cooks, chop the Mars Bar into small pieces and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix the ferment-kimchi with Salt and Black pepper, to taste.
Once the rice is cooked, fluff it with a fork and stir in the ferment-kimchi mixture.
Add the chopped Mars Bar to the rice mixture, and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and garnish with Fresh cilantro, if desired.
